item.title: Atamah pushes NSU to dominant victory in SLC opener
item.description: HAMMOND — An impressive double-double from Vernell Atamah, as well as a dominant performance on the glass, lifted Northwestern State to a resounding 69-52 victory at defending champion Southeastern Louisiana in the Southland Conference women’s basketball opener Sunday afternoon. item.description: Dr. Nicole Lobdell, assistant professor of English in the Louisiana Scholars’ College at Northwestern State University, was invited to discuss her research on the English writer Mary Shelley at the Keats-Shelley House in Rome, Italy, last month. item.title: Boys to Men Club nearly doubles goal in Thanksgiving food drive
item.description: The Boys to Men Club concluded its annual Thanksgiving Can Food Drive with impressive results, collecting nearly 900 cans and dry goods over a three-week period—far surpassing its original goal of 500. item.title: Natchitoches Christmas Festival is 99 years young!
item.description: The streets of Natchitoches were packed with festivalgoers Saturday, December 6 for the 99th Annual Christmas Festival as tens of thousands of visitors descended on the City of Lights for a day of parades, crafts, fireworks, and family fun.
